title: [windows] podman compose cgroups.controller errors on WSL3
body:
### Issue Description

So I just updated WSL to WSL 3.0.2 and since all my containers fail to start with the following error

```
Error response from daemon: crun: controller `pids` is not available under /sys/fs/cgroup/non-systemd/machine.slice/libpod-8a414d4ac565019d37fadf5fc021b2e1fd7f5160f1315353883d032bb713ffff.scope/container/cgroup.controllers: OCI runtime error
Error: executing C:\Users\owner\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\docker-compose.exe up -d: exit status 1
```

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. Install WSL 3.0.2
2. Attempt to run `podman compose up`
3. Observe error


### Describe the results you received

```
Error response from daemon: crun: controller `pids` is not available under /sys/fs/cgroup/non-systemd/machine.slice/libpod-8a414d4ac565019d37fadf5fc021b2e1fd7f5160f1315353883d032bb713ffff.scope/container/cgroup.controllers: OCI runtime error
Error: executing C:\Users\owner\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\docker-compose.exe up -d: exit status 1
```

### Describe the results you expected

Normal podman machines to start
